## A. Opening of Meeting

Chairman Mettey | Time: 5:00 p.m.

### #1 – Call to Order

Commissioner Mettey opened the meeting of the Board of Fire Commissioners with a verbal roll call of those present, followed by the Pledge of Allegiance and a prayer by Commissioner Lopez.

### #2 – Minutes

The Board of Fire Commissioners reviewed the minutes from the July 27, 2026 meeting.

### #3 – Fire Chief's Report

Fire Chief Kadlewicz provided the Board with updates regarding:

- Injured on Duty (IOD), Light Duty, Administrative Duty, Administrative Leave, Overtime Expenditures

### #4 – Old Business

**Recruitment/Medical Examinations:** The Board reviewed the progress of the newest recruits who have been offered positions and are currently completing the hiring process. Two recruits have successfully passed their medical examinations, while the Department is awaiting the results for three additional candidates. Fire Chief Kadlewicz explained the Local Registry process to the Board, including the criteria and requirements for hiring candidates from the Local Registry.

**Headquarters Roof Project:** No contractors submitted bids for the roof project at Headquarters, Station 1. Fire Chief Kadlewicz explained that he is uncertain what the next steps will be, as there appears to be no current interest from contractors in performing the work.

**Station 3 Waterproofing Project:** The Department is working with Purchasing to develop a Request for Proposals (RFP) for the coating and waterproofing project at Station 3. Fire Chief Kadlewicz stated that he is confident there will be contractor interest in this project.

**Capital Outlay:** The Capital Outlay request is currently before the Mayor and is awaiting presentation to the City Council. The Fire Department has identified several items and equipment that require upgrades and replacement.

**Turnout Gear:** The Department is in the process of ordering and upgrading turnout gear.

### #5 – New Business

There was no new business discussed at this meeting.

The Board discussed moving next month's meeting to **September 9, 2026, at 5:00 p.m.**

### #6 – Executive Session

An Executive Session was not needed for this meeting.

### #7 – Adjournment

The meeting was closed
